profiles.name: OpenSfield video editing

video.label: Source video (for motion transfer: the driving video)

refs.label: Reference picture
refs.description: replace_object: the new person/object. motion_transfer: your character. restyle and edit_video: the reference picture. Exactly one is used.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: What the result should look like (motion transfer: the motion prompt).

profiles.notes: Replace a person or object (SCAIL-2), move your character with a driving video (Wan Animate 2), restyle a clip from a reference picture (LTX), or edit a clip with a reference picture (Wan 2.2 Bernini-R). Size and length follow the source; there is no mask, box or size control. Slow (3-11 minutes measured).

profiles.name: Video upscale (SeedVR2)
profiles.notes: SeedVR2 video upscale at the workflow's own settings.

profiles.name: Smooth motion (FILM interpolation)
profiles.notes: FILM frame interpolation: 2x or 4x the frame rate.

profiles.name: Reverse Engineer Video (analysis)
profiles.notes: Measures shots, camera movement, light and colour from the pictures themselves and writes an editable plan. The job's picture is the contact sheet; the analysis document is served by GET /v1/reverse/{job}. It does not recover how a video was made.

unavailable.reason: SDXL-Turbo (Semechka's 'Sketch') exists only in Diffusers layout on the old engine; the OpenSfield ComfyUI has no verified SDXL workflow.
HunyuanVideo 1.5 runs only through the old engine's Diffusers pipeline; there is no ComfyUI workflow for it in OpenSfield.
HunyuanVideo 1.5 runs only through the old engine's Diffusers pipeline; there is no ComfyUI workflow for it in OpenSfield.
Wan 2.2 14B text-to-video: OpenSfield's ComfyUI has the 14B image-to-video and the 5B text-to-video workflows, not the 14B text-to-video one.

OpenJutsu (SAM 3.1 masks + MiniMax H3 reference-to-video with the Context-Loop nodes) lives only in the old engine's own ComfyUI install; it is not one of OpenSfield's verified workflows. The Studio operations (subject/character/object/vehicle replacement, motion transfer, restyling, advanced editing) are offered instead as the 'opensfield-video-edit' profile, which runs different models (SCAIL-2, Wan Animate 2, LTX restyle, Wan Bernini-R) and has no mask/box/size controls.
OpenJutsu reference-to-video: same as openjutsu-minimax-h3 (not an OpenSfield workflow).
